environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or request filtering. ALB access logs enabled but sent to S3 bucket with no alerting configured. Instance profile has AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore only.

config.network: public subnet, SG allows 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0
config.runtime: gunicorn 20.1.0, Python 3.9, no request sanitization middleware
